Sheldon Whitehouse (@SenWhitehouse)

The recent peculiar Alito WSJ editorial page interview puts him in more trouble than many appreciate. First, obviously, it’s opining about a question that might come before the Court, which all the justices in their confirmation hearings tell us is wrong. That’s easy.



— https://nitter.net/SenWhitehouse/status/1688193495847112705#m

Don’t give up on Alito as worst until you remember his fake “interview.” ⬇️
theguardian.com/commentisfre…

For instance, Zeldin is neck-deep in the conspiracy to stall clean energy, driving electric grids to more expensive fossil fuel units, raising electricity costs for customers, but sending billions to guess who?

Trump’s big corrupt fossil fuel donors!

Of course he is. 

This administration is run by corrupt fossil fuel billionaires and Zeldin is their obedient stooge. 

One more indicator of the depth of the corruption.  
politico.com/news/2026/04/25…
Here we go again. First Senate Rs delivered unanimous solution; House Rs drop ball. Now Senate Rs burn a reconciliation on this; House Rs look to fumble again.

Trump/Russia keeps happening in plain view. 
washingtonpost.com/national-…

Clean energy remains cheaper than fossil, and Trump’s war on clean energy (to help his fossil fuel donors) will keep hiking customer electricity costs.
subscriber.politicopro.com/a…

Coal keeps fading as renewables climb, even as Trump raises electricity costs by forcing expensive, polluting defunct coal plants back on line — part of his payoff (with your money) to his big fossil fuel donors.

Blame this on the U.S. fossil fuel industry death-grip on Trump and Republicans. 
politico.eu/article/france-d…

Add that Trump’s mental incapacity may lead him to deliberately pull Republicans down with him. Better pull your whole house down than fail alone.  
usatoday.com/story/opinion/c…

This news helps confirm suspicions about the Fulton County elections search warrant affidavit, that it was never intended for a criminal investigation, just to grab election records after other efforts to get at the documents failed.


Reuters (@Reuters)

Exclusive: President Donald Trump granted aide Kurt Olsen, a prominent election-denier, broad leeway to use federal money and staff to chase discredited election-rigging theories, even after there was no trace of hacking, Reuters found reut.rs/

Thank you Thom Tillis for calling BS on this. (As did a federal judge, btw.)
washingtonpost.com/business/…

Take “Had No Plan,” add “Aging Addled Brain,” and stir.
washingtonpost.com/politics/…

Hmmm. “You investigate my boozing and jet jaunts and we investigate you”?
nytimes.com/2026/04/22/us/po…

McKibben gets it. No damned “hushing”! Not with home insurance markets melting down and electricity bills soaring!! 
billmckibben.substack.com/p/…

Guess who’s missing that market surge as Trump hobbles American EV progress? Trump is sending China an engraved invitation to stomp our domestic companies, all for his corrupt fossil fuel donors. 
theguardian.com/environment/…

Oh, my. Could Kash Patel have been lying about who was lying here? He did, after all, lie to our committee.


nxthompson (@nxthompson)
